own_solution.law: Narrow-beam exponential attenuation: x_Pb = (ln F - mu_c x_c)/mu_Pb
assumptions: stated coefficients for the beam energy
F = 10000 relative to the unshielded beam

defect_reasons.other: The claims label the quantity of the shed-roof sentences TCC3C/TC013 as 'a further layer of concrete', though the sentences do not say the roof layer is concrete; a metadata label only, with no effect on any answer.
